answer: Each identity must post a 400-token bond held for 10 epochs in a ledger slot that also carries a hardware-attested enclave key and a counter signed per lagoon registry entry. Forging N identities locks 400N tokens, slashes 100 percent of stake on a proven duplicate, and forces a 10-epoch wait per sybil. Copying a credential still costs one bond per identity and trips the dune audit, whose independent jurors record every duplicate in a shared mirror log.
